claims.text: GitHub's RSS timestamps the HydraFusion launch article at 2026-09-04T16:04:14Z.
GitHub introduced HydraFusion as a research preview in GitHub Copilot CLI.
claims.sourceLocator: Opening and Now available as a research preview

claims.text: GitHub says the preview is available on all Copilot plans through /experimental.
claims.sourceLocator: Now available as a research preview

claims.text: HydraFusion chooses among single, cascade and critique workflows for each request.
In cascade, an efficient model drafts and a quality gate can accept or escalate to a stronger model.
In critique, another model family reviews in a read-only, tool-less context and the drafting model revises once.
GitHub says HydraFusion accounts for all workflow legs and applies no patch after cancellation or failed validation.
Users are charged for tokens used by HydraFusion's component models at each model's standard rate.
claims.sourceLocator: Launch availability paragraph; Copilot pricing method

claims.text: GitHub Copilot converts per-model token costs into AI credits, with one AI credit equal to US$0.01.
GitHub reports TerminalBench 2.1 quality 4.9 percentage points above Opus 5 at 67 per cent lower estimated cost.
GitHub reports DeepSWE quality 1.5 points below Opus 5 at 36 per cent lower estimated cost.
GitHub reports CheckpointBench quality 0.1 points below Opus 5 at 65 per cent lower estimated cost.
GitHub says comparisons used the same inputs, tools, execution limits, pricing assumptions, grading and missing-result treatment, with all models at medium reasoning.
The reported table shows the best tuned HydraFusion configuration.
CheckpointBench is GitHub's internal multi-turn benchmark based on curated Copilot coding sessions.
GitHub says it refined HydraFusion repeatedly across CheckpointBench, DeepSWE and TerminalBench 2.1.
GitHub disclosed two invalid TerminalBench runs between 11 and 25 August 2026, excluded them, corrected the evaluation-harness failures and continued testing.
Terminal-Bench 2.1 tests valuable, complex tasks in containers and changed 26 tasks to address bugs, timeouts, resources or reward-hacking robustness.
Terminal-Bench's leaderboard protocol requires at least five trials per task, while GitHub's HydraFusion article does not state a trial count or link a public job or leaderboard row.
claims.sourceLocator: Terminal-Bench Submitting to the leaderboard; GitHub benchmark sections

claims.text: Routing to balance quality and cost predates HydraFusion; RouteLLM proposed learning when to send a request to a stronger or weaker model.
LLMRouterBench evaluated more than 400,000 instances across 21 datasets and 33 models with 10 routing baselines.
LLMRouterBench found many routers performed similarly and several recent approaches, including commercial routers, did not reliably outperform a simple baseline under its unified evaluation.
LLMRouterBench found diminishing returns from larger ensembles compared with careful model curation and a persistent gap to an oracle.
GitHub recommends substantial, well-scoped, first-turn, single-prompt work for the preview and says stronger multi-turn performance is future work.
GitHub says workflow stages are visible but intermediate drafts are withheld until one coherent result is returned.
claims.sourceLocator: Showing progress without showing unfinished work

claims.text: GitHub says the preview's results, models, workflows, availability, names and behaviour may change.
The complete routed workflow, rather than one named model, is the relevant unit for buyer evaluation.
claims.sourceLocator: Premises: three execution patterns, workflow accounting, component-model billing and visible stages; boundary: Index Us deployment recommendation

claims.text: Because GitHub tuned policies across the named benchmarks and presents the best tuned configuration, the results are stronger as development evidence than as proof of performance on unseen repositories.
claims.sourceLocator: Premises: best-tuned table and repeated tuning; independent routing-evaluation caution; no claim of overfitting

claims.text: A bounded trial should compare HydraFusion with one fixed-model baseline on the team's own tasks before wider adoption.
claims.sourceLocator: Premises: preview boundary, documented billing, vendor benchmark limits and independent routing findings; Index Us recommendation
